what: parity against craftax at 32 px -- a size craftax ships no textures for, whose renderer is therefore CONSTRUCTED through craftax load_all_textures_given_size(32). Not a certification size and not a parity obligation; measured because the resolution-consistency argument turns on what differs at 2S and where.
conclusion: the WORLD rows are 100% exact against craftax at 32 px in every band, night included, so the 2S divergence is entirely the inventory strip: ~18% of strip pixels, by design (the finished cell is resampled rather than re-laid-out). craftax ships no 32 px textures, which is why 32 px is not a declared parity size -- not because its frames would disagree.
